instruction: A candid studio photograph of three women sitting closely on a white floor, framed by blurry wildflowers in the foreground. On the left, the curly-haired woman in a white shirt (R1) sits leaning back. In the center, the straight-haired woman in a white sleeveless top (R2) sits upright, embraced by both friends. On the right, the curly-haired woman in a black tank top (R3) leans in from behind. Bright, soft lighting illuminates the clean, warm scene.
